text:
claire (procurement): FYI Vendor Beta put 10 H200s on 'RMA-hold' citing connector corrosion after humidity exposure at origin. PO-84211 now ETA 3w -> 7w.
omar (supply-ops): Oof. Those were earmarked for EU dedicated pool. Any quick releases?
marta (vendor-beta): We can release 4 cleaned units in 12d after bench rework (+$360/unit) or send 6 loaners now (refurb) with daily fee. We can also absorb up to €250/unit in extra import costs if customs reclassify repairs.
tess (logistics): Split AWBs + repair docs will be required. Cross-border swap through FR crossdock ok but need repair affidavit and tech slot 48-72h per unit. Customs risk noted.
raj (eng-runtime): Losing 10 pushes batch tail latency ~15% and increases retry churn. Ballpark customer impact ~€27k over 6w.
claire (procurement): Quick economics: rework + freight ~ $360 + $95 share ~= $455/unit. Loaner 30d ~ $2.5k/unit. Vendor credit if we accept delay?
marta (vendor-beta): Offer 7% invoice credit on delayed units, or 9% if you sign a Q3 top-off addendum. Waive rework fee on first 2 cleaned units if addendum signed.
omar (supply-ops): Proposal: accept 4 cleaned (waive fee on first 2), take 6 delayed with 9% credit. Ask vendor to provide serials + bench logs immediately.
tess (logistics): Once serials in, I'll book DAP courier and reserve crossdock bay. Need supplier affidavit and HS-code repair declaration to reduce inspection risk.
marta (vendor-beta): Will send serials, bench logs, firmware diffs, and draft affidavit EOD. Will cc legal@vendor-beta.com on addendum.
ops-bot: Ticket created: INF-9501 - "Vendor Beta H200 corrosion RMA-hold and partial release plan". Assignees: tess, omar, claire. Link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INF-9501
raj (eng-runtime): Gate any pre-validated units behind 48h ramp and thermal telemetry. If firmware diff present, include test vectors.
claire (procurement): Good. Next steps: 1) Marta sends docs EOD; 2) Legal to draft addendum for 9% credit + waived fees; 3) Logistics to book DAP on receipt; 4) Eng to validate safe rollout. I'll loop in Finance.
marta (vendor-beta): Understood. Thanks all.
omar (supply-ops): :thumbsup:
